nights.title: Bedouine
nights.name: Bedouine
nights.extract: Azniv Korkejian, known by her stage name Bedouine, is a Syrian-American musician. She has lived in a number of cities and countries, including Saudi Arabia, Houston, Syria, and Boston.

nights.title: Colby Acuff
nights.name: Colby Acuff
nights.extract: Colby Acuff is an American country singer-songwriter from Coeur d'Alene, Idaho. His major label debut album Western White Pines released just one month after signing to Sony in May 2023.

en.kicker: american country singer-songwriter · Coeur d'Alene, Idaho
